''See also: [[Shepherds (Elder Empire) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Shepherds are a specialized group within the [[Consultant's Guild]], serving as dedicated servants of [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]. They are characterized by their black clothing and masks, often acting as a silent presence that follows orders with absolute precision. Rather than being trained for combat or assassination, their primary expertise lies in reconnaissance, observation, and infiltration. Their rigorous training involves mastering skills such as memory retention, climbing, and navigating difficult environments to gather accurate intelligence. While they are highly effective at gathering information, they are noted for being skittish and lack significant combat proficiency. Beyond their roles as spies, Shepherds also perform various utility tasks, such as cleaning up scenes or transporting bodies. They operate under a strict hierarchy, which includes a High Shepherd.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Shepherds serve as highly trained consultants specializing in stealth and observation. These entities, who appear as black shadows dressed in black clothing, provide vital information and observations within an area. While four Shepherds once remained on standby to observe that [[Rudeus Maxwell]] was a nobody, the group is also known to act as forces that could be lost during operations. Members of this crew, including those armed with muskets to surround a crater, have served alongside [[Meia]] and may be sent on assignments with [[Shera]]. The group has also been utilized by [[Kerian]], and the individual [[Tyril]] was noted to have risen from among them.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|As a specialized group within the [[Consultants]], the Shepherds are dedicated to the tasks of scouting and observation. Rather than focusing on combat, these individuals undergo training in reconnaissance and watchful monitoring to protect the flock. They carry [[steel]] blades on their ankles and possess the ability to materialize to serve as attendants or guards. During their pursuit of [[Kerian]] and [[Shera]], the group was actively preparing for war.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Shepherds are an order of black-clad [[Consultants]] who utilize skintight black silks as their symbolic attire. Functioning as spies rather than assassins, they often hide to demonstrate their skills or watch from rooftops to prevent eavesdropping. During certain events, members of the order provided [[Shera]] with water, a stool, and a headache pill, while others were positioned to spread discontent through the distribution of news-sheets. Although some Shepherds were incapacitated and a team was dispatched by [[Shera]], others remained active to remove chairs from a conference room and carry the bound [[Ayana]] away.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
